description: Prospective NCAAB challengers: refits of the frozen parameters recorded point-in-time within two hours of tip-off at the line the served forecast prices, in the separate challenger store, scored at read time against the served forecast. Registration is never promotion; nothing here reaches serving, cards or betting. C1 and C2 differ only in the fit sample (C2 includes the spent test seasons).

spec.name: ncaab_refit_c1
spec.head: winner+spread+total
spec.why: C1: weekly refit of the winner Platt calibration and the margin/total sigmas on results available at the week start, excluding the spent test seasons 2025/2026.

provenance.registered_by: learning-phase2 I5 seed (Claude Sonnet 5.5); owner review pending
provenance.note: Manual operator seed for the prospective NCAAB challengers (docs/NCAAB_PLAN.md): the served NCAAB models stay frozen; only calibration and sigmas are refit weekly, point-in-time. Owner decision 2026-11-18: challengers may be fitted on the already-spent test seasons 2025/2026; evidence comes only from rows recorded before tip-off.

spec.name: ncaab_refit_c2_incl_test
spec.head: winner+spread+total
spec.why: C2: the same refit as C1 but fitted on every season with results, explicitly including the spent test seasons (owner-allowed), so the effect of the extra seasons is visible.

spec.why: C3: the total priced by the existing college_eff joint-normal total instead of the served running_points model (the one alternative total model already in the codebase), sigma refit as C1.
